title: THE MEDICAL KEY NEVER BINDS A BANDAGE YOU DO NOT HAVE
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. In a raid at full health, carrying only Medkits, dragging the Medical belt key to another key to give the heals a key of their own said Bandage to slot 6 and saved a grey Bandage key with nothing behind it, while the Medkits stayed on Medical. At full health the Medical key shows a Bandage picture as a stand-in, and the drag took that picture for the item. The drag now starts only when the backpack really holds the heal the key shows, as the Undercroft belt has done since v15.69. A Medkit can still be put on any key from its backpack tile.
now: In a raid at full health, dragging the Medical belt key no longer binds a Bandage you do not carry.
